### Description

A clear and concise description of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

### Related Issues

Fixes #(issue number)

### Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Scientific / Algorithmic enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

### Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project formatting and linting guidelines (`ruff check` & `ruff format`)
- [ ] Type annotations pass without errors (`mypy src/grid_disturbance`)
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass (`pytest`)
- [ ] Mathematical formulations and physical assumptions are documented
- [ ] Relevant documentation or docstrings have been updated
